name: SIEM
description: Send log events to Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems like Splunk, Elastic, or Datadog. Supports HTTP/HTTPS endpoints with authentication and batching for efficient log transmission.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: SIEM HTTP endpoint URL for log ingestion

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: API key or authentication token for SIEM access

parameters.name: batch_size
parameters.description: Number of log events to batch before sending

parameters.name: batch_timeout_ms
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait before sending partial batch

parameters.name: compression
parameters.description: Enable gzip compression for log transmission

examples.description: Configure SIEM log storage for Datadog
examples.output: Log storage configured. Crypto operations will be sent to Datadog SIEM.

name: S3
description: Store log events in Amazon S3 buckets with automatic partitioning by date and log type. Supports encryption at rest and configurable retention policies.

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: S3 bucket name for log storage

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: S3 key prefix for organizing logs

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: AWS region where the bucket is located

examples.description: Configure S3 log storage with Parquet format

name: PostgreSQL
description: Store log events in a PostgreSQL database table with full SQL query capabilities. Ideal for centralized logging across multiple DuckDB instances with long-term retention.

parameters.name: auto_create_table
parameters.description: Automatically create table if it does not exist

parameters.name: async_write
parameters.description: Write logs asynchronously to avoid blocking queries

examples.description: Store logs in PostgreSQL for centralized monitoring
